tool_args.rationale: Subtracting the current state and dividing by the signed input step yields a positive, smoothly decaying response with slowing apparent decay. A numerically fitted two-mode relaxation captures that structure and preserves the observed zero-step baseline.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The normalized step response has a changing logarithmic decay rate across horizons, inconsistent with a single exponential.
The observed opposing shifts track the sign of the input step and preserve the zero-step baseline.
The seven nonzero-step observations already constrain a four-parameter two-mode relaxation; fresh confirmation is more useful.
